description: This file defines the SpecialOperator class within the SuiteCRM JSON API filters operators namespace. It extends a base Operator class and provides functionality for handling special string-based operators that match a specific regex pattern, including validation and conversion methods.

classes.name: SpecialOperator
classes.description: A class representing a special type of operator used in filtering, matching specific string patterns enclosed in triple square brackets. It includes methods for validation and checking if a string matches its pattern.

methods.name: toFilterTag
methods.description: Converts an operator string to its filter tag representation by delegating to the parent class method.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the provided operator string is valid according to the defined rules, throwing an exception if the input is not a string.

methods.name: isOperator
methods.description: Determines if a string is a recognized operator based on pattern matching and validity checks.

methods.name: totalOperands
methods.description: Returns the total number of operands expected after the operator, which is zero for this special operator.
